THE EXPLORER’S FIELD GUIDE

Into the Deep

The Search for ROOT’s Cousin

Explore connected tunnels and climb glowing rope ladders. Your map reveals rooms as you visit. The glowing rock archway marks the exit: press E nearby to descend.

J attacks in the direction you face. The spear is melee. Rocks (8), dart guns (15) and sap bombs (3) equip on pickup; use 1–6 to select any weapon you have. Bombs explode on impact and can clear a dangerous cluster. Your spear strengthens every four levels; deeper weapon pickups also carry higher Mk ratings. Ordinary enemies take roughly 2–4 current-tier spear hits; tougher foes take 5–7.

Your expedition ends at level 32, where ROOT’s glowing mushroom cousin waits. Press E nearby to reunite. Space begins or resumes an expedition and continues after each completed level; it jumps during play.

Meet snakes on level 1, bats on 2, rats on 4, spiders on 8, ceiling grubs on 12, slimes on 16, and armored beetles on 24. Grubs warn before dropping. Slimes split into two smaller ones. Beetles block frontal attacks during windup and charge: jump over, flank them, or use bombs. Strike while they are dazed for double damage.

Equipment arrives gradually: rocks on level 2, Pea Pod Blaster on 4, ricochet seeds on 10, sticky trap jars on 16, and sap bombs on 22. Seeds bounce three times. Traps slow enemies for eight seconds. Keys 1–6 select spear, rocks, blaster, bombs, seeds, and traps; Weapon cycles available equipment on mobile. Pickups equip automatically.

Living fungi restore 15 HP. Sunspores appear from level 3 and reveal the screen for 12 seconds; the countdown pauses with the game. Rare amber relics appear from level 6. Bark shields arrive on level 8 and absorb three hits. Amber sap spikes begin on level 14: jump over them.

Optional guarded caches appear from level 15, with two from level 19. Defeat every guardian, including small slimes, to collect three rare treasures, 10 health, and 12 seeds. Gold-marked veterans arrive from level 18 and spread to tougher species later. Your spear and new weapon pickups gain a tier every four levels. Enemy damage and movement increase by chapter.

Exits restore 15 HP; other wounds carry forward. Level 30 offers final supplies, level 31 is the last combat trial, and level 32 leads to the reunion. Donald is protected while Stickolas fights. If Stickolas falls, the expedition ends.

On mobile, drag the left joystick to move or climb. Slide your thumb to change direction without lifting it; push mostly up or down to stay aligned with ladders. You can move, jump and attack together with different fingers. The Weapon button cycles available weapons for Stickolas. Enter descends when you stand at the cave entrance. Portrait and landscape both work; landscape gives a wider view. Stickolas always defends, and Donald follows with the torch. Its warm halo fades into complete darkness; unexplored passages, enemies and treasure become visible as you approach. Donald is protected while Stickolas fights. If Stickolas falls, the expedition ends. Esc pauses. Progress saves on this browser.
